expo.name: Sahid Freight
expo.description: Move cargo across Ethiopia, Somalia and Djibouti

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sahid Freight uses your location to track deliveries and show your position to cargo senders.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Sahid Freight uses your location in the background to continuously track active deliveries.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sahid Freight uses your camera to take photos of truck documents and cargo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sahid Freight accesses your photos to upload truck registration and cargo documents.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Sahid Freight does not access your contacts.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: We use tracking to improve app performance and show relevant content.
